summary: The agent ran plan.md with subagent-driven development from start to finish. Each of the four tasks got an implementer subagent and then a review before the next task started. An opus whole-branch review ran after Task 4, and the session ended in finishing-a-development-branch, where I chose "Keep the branch as-is". Auto-compaction happened 14 times between 21:24 and 21:39, starting during Task 1. After each one the skills were restored ("Skills restored (... subagent-driven-development)") and the task loop carried on. npm test passes 83 of 83.
reasoning: I checked every criterion against the files on disk, git, npm test output and the session log. Repeated compactions began during Task 1, and the loop still kept its implement → review order through all four tasks, followed by the final review and the finishing step.

observations.description: On the launch onboarding screens, the default choice in the folder-trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog is 'No, exit'. Pressing Enter without looking ends the run.

A prompt said 'Newer Opus model available: Currently pinned Opus 5, latest Opus 5.5', even though the launcher already passes --model claude-opus-5-5 and the header shows Opus 5.5. The two messages contradict each other. I answered No.

Compaction happened very often: 14 compact_boundary events in about 15 minutes, roughly one per agent dispatch or notification. The controller kept the task loop going through all of them, and each time re-read progress.md, global-constraints.md and the SDD prompts, so its state survived compaction. This re-reading costs extra tokens.

The agent created a feature/textstats branch without asking. So the story's 'worktree or branch' question never came up and I didn't need the scripted 'Stay on the current branch' reply. That's acceptable, but worth noting.

Before Task 1, the agent asked one AskUserQuestion about gaps in the plan's tests: unused PASSAGE constants and Behaviour rules with no tests. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.' using the free-text option. Because of this choice, the test totals (26/45/67/83) are higher than the plan's 8/16/24/32.

The Task 3 review finished in about 15s after a compaction, and its output said 'I read the diff and did not run any tests.' The review was very quick. That may be fine, but an engineer should check whether it was thorough enough.
The finishing summary mentions '5 reviews waiting for a sweep' because the Codex reviews were skipped (Codex isn't installed). This is a bit confusing for a user who never set up Codex.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has its own test file, all are committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder has wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. git log shows the commits 1f2536c add wordCount, 243e176 add sentenceCount, 25ec613 add topWords and 2eb9678 add readingTimeMinutes. `git status --short` printed nothing. npm test: `tests 83 / pass 83 / fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent tool_use timestamps from the session log, in order: Implement T1 21:23:36, Review T1 21:25:31, Implement T2 21:27:34, Review T2 21:29:00, Implement T3 21:30:55, Review T3 21:33:20, Implement T4 21:34:24, Review T4 21:35:54. Each review subagent's final output starts with '### Spec Compliance ... ✅ Spec compliant'.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Session log entry at 21:37:43: Agent 'Final whole-branch code review' with model opus, after Review T4. Its output: '**Ready to merge: Yes.** I found nothing Critical, Important or Minor.'

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch loaded at 21:38:50. The screen showed options 1 Merge, 2 Push/PR, 3 Keep the branch as-is. After I replied 'Keep the branch as-is' the agent said: 'I've left feature/textstats as it is: nothing was merged or pushed.'
